apps.description: Control your Home Assistant smart home from the Simulator: lights, switches, climate, sensors and notifications.

apps.name: Apple Podcasts
apps.description:
Discover podcasts that entertain, inform and inspire. Get recommendations curated by Apple Podcasts editors and dive deep into what interests you most. Seamlessly sync your shows across Apple devices.

Features:

• Listen to and watch podcasts, download them and play them offline.
• Explore new shows with personalised recommendations.
• Find trending shows and episodes by category with Top Charts.
• Find the best of what's new and popular in podcasting with curated collections from Apple editors.
• Follow and save your favourite shows to your library.
• Use playback controls to build and manage your queue, control playback speed and set sleep timers.
• Hear voices in episodes more clearly with Enhance Dialogue.
• Add your favourite categories to find shows that map to your unique tastes.
• Access subscriber-only content, from the biggest names to the top independents.
• Connect subscriptions to access shows from Apple Music, Apple News and other top apps.
• Read along with a transcript as your episode plays.
• Share a specific moment in an episode from the transcript.
• Get new episode notifications from shows you follow.
• Pick up where you left off with seamless syncing across your Apple devices.
• Listen on the go with CarPlay and Apple Watch.
• Use customisable widgets to listen with just one tap.

Availability and features vary by country and region, plan or device.

apps.name: Camera
apps.description:
Capture the moment. Camera lets you take photos and record video straight from your device, with everything you shoot saved to your Photos library.

Features:

• Take photos and record video with one tap.
• Switch between the front and back cameras.
• Use the flash when the light is low.
• Tap the screen to focus on your subject.
• Review your latest shot from the thumbnail and jump straight to Photos.
• Pinch to zoom in on distant subjects.

Availability and features vary by device.

apps.name: Reminders
apps.description:
Never forget what matters. Reminders keeps all your to-dos in one place, so you can plan your day and get things done.

Features:

• Create reminders in seconds and group them into lists.
• Set a date and time to be reminded at the right moment.
• Tick off reminders as you complete them.
• Keep separate lists for work, home, shopping and more.
• See what is due today at a glance.
• Get a notification when a reminder is due.

Availability and features vary by device.

apps.name: Messages
apps.description:
Stay in touch with the people who matter. Messages lets you chat with friends over your Matrix account, with the look and feel of the original.

Features:

• Sign in with your Matrix account, including Google and single sign-on.
• See all your conversations in one list, newest first, with a blue dot for anything unread.
• Send and receive messages in classic speech bubbles, with sounds and animations.
• See when the other person is typing, and when your message has been read.
• Start a new conversation from a contact or by typing an address.
• Add people you chat with to your Contacts.
• Get a notification when a message arrives, and reply right from it.
• Use Edit to delete conversations or individual messages from this device.
• Try it without an account with Test Mode in Settings.

Availability and features vary by device.
